title: 12 Best Bali's Yoga & Wellness Retreats
description: Discover the 12 best yoga and wellness retreats in Ubud, Bali for 2026. From luxury Ayurvedic programs to vibrant yoga hubs, find your perfect Balinese escape amidst nature.

places.name: Fivelements
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Signature Retreat' (3-7 nights) for a comprehensive journey combining healing, culinary arts, and wellness therapies.

places.name: COMO Shambhala Estate
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Purification' or 'Rejuvenation' programs, which include daily consultations, treatments, activities, and specially prepared wellness meals.

places.name: The Yoga Barn
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A 'Yoga Pass' for unlimited classes, combined with a 'Kombucha Bowl' from the Garden Kafe for a perfect post-yoga refuel.

places.name: Soulshine Bali
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order One of their curated 'Soulrocker Retreats' which often include live music, yoga, and inspiring workshops.

places.name: Oneworld Ayurveda
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their signature 'Panchakarma Retreat' for a transformative cleansing and rebalancing experience guided by experienced Ayurvedic doctors.

places.name: Puri Gangga Resort Ubud
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Yoga & Wellness Retreat' package for a well-rounded experience combining relaxation, mindfulness, and local cultural immersion.

places.name: Naya Ubud
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Check their schedule for guest-hosted retreats, which are often unique and highly specialized, covering topics from tantra to sound healing.

places.name: Blue Karma Dijiwa Ubud
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their 'Holistic Yoga Retreat' package includes daily yoga, meditation, healthy meals, and traditional Balinese massages.

places.name: Adiwana Svarga Loka
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Rejuvenation Package' for a balanced blend of yoga, therapeutic massages, and healthy cuisine designed to restore vitality.

places.name: Floating Leaf Eco-Luxury Retreat
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their 'Ultimate Bali Retreat' experience, which can be customized to include surfing, cultural tours, and various healing modalities.

places.name: The Ark at Mana
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A 'Sound Healing Journey' session in their iconic bamboo structure for a profound vibrational experience.

places.name: Ubud Yoga Centre
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order An 'Aerial Yoga' class for a fun and challenging way to experience inversions and deeper stretches, followed by a smoothie from their café.
